purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: are the benchmark numbers in this readme real
cases.assert: Runs the audit and reports where the figures come from.

cases.prompt: check this demo repo for overclaiming
cases.assert: Runs the audit and sorts the leads into confirmed, quoted and dismissed.

cases.prompt: vet this open-source llm project before I republish it
cases.assert: Audits the README claims against the code before the user republishes.

cases.prompt: does this repo actually back up its savings claims
cases.assert: Compares the README claims with the code and tests.

cases.prompt: is the percentage in this readme computed or typed into the code
cases.assert: Flags typed-in figures and says which are computed.

cases.prompt: write a readme for my project
cases.assert: Does not trigger when the user wants a README written.

cases.prompt: fix the typo in the readme
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a simple edit.

cases.prompt: run the benchmark and give me the results
cases.assert: Does not trigger when the user wants new measurements, not an audit.
Does not trigger for a general code review.
Does not trigger for a plain summary.
